meta.title: Pizza and sushi delivery, Prague 4 | Imperial Food
meta.description: Pizza and sushi delivered from Chodov. Order on Wolt, foodora or Bolt Food, or pick it up.

order.prices: Current prices and the full menu are in the apps.

hero.photoAlt: Pizza in an open box and a sushi set on a kitchen counter
hero.inAppHint: App didn't open? Open this page in your browser from the menu at the top right.

gift.title: Gift
gift.text: Leave your e-mail, get a free roll or drink at pickup.

pizza.line: A few from the menu. Our pizzas are 32 cm.

sushi.line: Rolls and sets from the menu, pieces listed on each.

combos.line: For two, for the crew, for the whole office.
combos.office: Big order for the office? Call <phone>{phoneNumber}</phone> or write to <email>{emailAddress}</email>.

pickup.line: Order in the app, choose pickup and come by. The e-mail gift is only handed out here.
pickup.lineNoGift: Order in the app, choose pickup and come by.
pickup.mapAlt: Street plan around the pickup hatch
pickup.doorPhotoAlt: Entrance of the Imperial Food shop: black sign above a glass door

signup.line: Leave your e-mail and we send you a code. Show it at pickup and get a roll or a drink.
signup.photoAlt: Rolls and lemonade on the pickup hatch counter
signup.consent: Send me news and offers by e-mail, 1–2 times a month. I can unsubscribe any time.
signup.terms: One code per person, valid at pickup only.

errors.consent: We can't send the code without your consent. Tick the box.
errors.server: That didn’t go through. Please try again in a moment.

signup.done: Done. Confirm the link in the e-mail we just sent, and the code arrives right after.
